people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “Yahweh is righteous.”
translations.bsb: So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The LORD is righteous.”
translations.kjv: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.
translations.asv: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, Jehovah is righteous.
